thread:
alex.h: Hey! First day — I completed the Okta invite but I can't access the Redwood GitHub org or the 'eng' Google group. Clicking 'Sign in with Okta' redirects to an error: 'User not assigned to app'. Any ideas?
manny.peopleops: I sent the invite and approved you earlier today. Can you confirm the email you used? pinging @olivia.it to triage provisioning.
olivia.it: On it. Can you paste the exact error text or a screenshot? Also confirm your company email (is it alex.h@redwood.ai?).
alex.h: Yep it's alex.h@redwood.ai — error text shows: "User not assigned to this application". In Okta I can log in but I don't see the Github app in Assigned Apps. 1Password shared vault is missing too.
it-bot: Provisioning event: user_create alex.h processed. orgUnit=contractors, assigned_groups=[].
olivia.it: Ah — looks like you were placed in the contractors orgUnit, which has restricted app access. I'll move you to the employees OU and trigger a sync. Can you sign out of Okta and sign back in after ~2 minutes?
alex.h: Signed out. Also trying to register my YubiKey on 1Password gives 'no devices allowed' error — might be related.
olivia.it: Re-assigned you to orgUnit=employees and forced a sync. Can you check Okta > Profile to confirm orgUnit shows 'employees' and that 'Github' appears under Assigned Apps?
alex.h: Profile now shows orgUnit: employees and Github is listed. Re-signed in and I can clone private repos :tada:. 1Password vault still not visible though.
olivia.it: Adding you to the eng-vault now. For the YubiKey, once you're in the eng group go to 1Password > Account > Security > Add device. If it still errors, paste the exact message.
manny.peopleops: Thanks @olivia.it — I'll note the orgUnit mapping issue in the invite template so future new-hires don't hit this. Welcome again @alex.h!
alex.h: Confirmed 1Password vault appeared and I was able to register my YubiKey. All set. Huge thanks to everyone! :heart:
